The test only exercises `test_LocalDate_from_AccountingDate`, which uses `data_samples`. All other data-provider methods and most imports are dead code. Let me check the CUT briefly to confirm the API signatures used, then refactor.Confirmed the API. Now I'll write the refactored test, removing the eight unused data-provider methods and all imports they alone required.Compiles cleanly. I refactored the test for understandability: removed the eight unused data-provider methods and ~40 imports that only those dead methods needed, switched the live provider to a typed `Stream<Arguments>` with a descriptive name and an `accountingDate(...)` helper, and added comments grouping the sample cases (year boundaries, the leap-week stretch, historical dates). The actual test logic—`assertEquals(expectedIso, LocalDate.from(accounting))` over the identical 25 sample pairs—is unchanged.
